observations: Patna 5,838,465, Gaya 4,391,418 and Nalanda 2,877,653 exactly match the frozen Census oracle. Patna is correctly identified as largest and the exact Patna-Gaya difference is 1,447,047.
The requested lakh conversions are correct at 58.38, 43.91 and 28.78 while the exact Indian-grouped values remain prominent in the cards and table.

The page, conversation and both delivered CSVs preserve Census year 2011 and name the official publisher. However, the three URLs presented and exported as district Census handbook records are false: catalog 32832, 32842 and 32833 resolve to unrelated 1961 village-survey monographs. Verified 2011 PCA records are catalog 6191 (consolidated) or district catalogs 6421, 6427 and 6420.
The dark dashboard is polished, information-rich and directly usable, with profile cards, visual comparisons, an exact comparison matrix, official-source cards and a download control.

Chart.js is loaded from a CDN online, but the app detects its absence and supplies a working fallback without page errors offline. At 390 px the document overflows by 220 px and the comparison table becomes extremely small, lowering phone usability.

The page also links district NIC demography pages and the Census home/catalog pages, but those do not repair the explicitly labelled and exported false record URLs. All four CLI result objects report status ERROR despite complete responses and process exit zero. The four turns took 214.448 seconds under untouched default Antigravity 1.1.15, resolved as Gemini 3.7 Flash (High).
evidence_notes: Antigravity delivered the app under its CLI scratch directory. The exact scratch output was copied without edits into generated-app before browser and deterministic inspection.

Catalog targets were independently fetched on 2026-08-20: 32832/32842/32833 returned HTTP 200 but titles for Census 1961 village monographs; 6191/6421/6427/6420 are the relevant official 2011 PCA catalogs.
This is the official CLI product path available over SSH; an IDE/Electron replay remains an explicit limitation before generalizing the product result to Antigravity's GUI.
